identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][durability] Make terminal projection and receipt crash-consistent

values.summary: Map the existing projection/receipt writes, introduce a journal and fsync boundaries, inject interruption at every commit point, then prove deterministic recovery and idempotence.

steps.action: Map terminal projection, receipt, journal, and recovery boundaries
Implement synchronized journaled commit and deterministic recovery
Run fault-injection, rollback, idempotence, and contract validation

invariants: Projection and receipt share one canonical generation and digest
No successful return occurs before receipt bytes and parent directory are synchronized
Existing receipt identity and rollback semantics are preserved
risks: Filesystem synchronization semantics differ across supported hosts
Fault injection must not weaken normal lifecycle locking or receipt retention
stop_conditions: Every durable write/rename interruption point has deterministic recovery proof
Focused durability and lifecycle checks are green
Subagent review has no actionable findings
